adversarial_audit.objection: GPE performs only weak irrep measurement.
adversarial_audit.resolution: Do not measure or discard its Fourier registers. The coherent Bacon-Chuang-Harrow output explicitly exports the carrier row.

adversarial_audit.objection: Unknown Kronecker multiplicity bases prevent transport.
adversarial_audit.resolution: The group action and GPE are identity on multiplicity spaces, so the circuit preserves them without naming a basis.

adversarial_audit.objection: The inverse carrier correlation still requires amplitude amplification.
adversarial_audit.resolution: The scalar 1/d belongs to E F, not to its polar U. The GPE circuit implements U directly.

adversarial_audit.objection: A fast S_n QFT automatically gives a full Kronecker transform.
adversarial_audit.resolution: GPE gives the narrower carrier-export isometry needed here; it does not provide explicit multiplicity coordinates or general recoupling matrices.

adversarial_audit.objection: Efficient pair polar transport solves the full decoder.
adversarial_audit.resolution: The complete frame contains exponentially many coherently incident projectors. Higher-order relative polar structure remains unproved.

circuit_contract.operation: Use inverse S_n QFT on the trivial Fourier basis state to prepare uniform permutation registers.
Apply controlled diagonal S_n actions on R_0,R_a,R_b and the forward QFT, retaining irrep, row, and column registers.
Check alpha_0=alpha_a=alpha_b and swap row_a with row_b only on that equality sector.
Invert all three GPE transforms; multiplicity registers were never measured or modified.

claim_gate.reason: Generalized phase estimation gives an explicit polynomial direct pair-polar transport and defeats the normalized-access barrier. The research bottleneck moves to coherent higher-order frame composition, not pair carrier conditioning.

falsifiers_triggered: High-dimensional natural carrier mass blocks normalized cross-overlap QSVT but does not block direct pair polar transport.
A complete symmetric-group Kronecker transform is stronger than necessary for pair transport; coherent GPE row access suffices.
Pair transport is no longer a defensible main bottleneck. Future work must attack higher-order relative-frame composition.

literature_links.use: Generalized nonabelian phase-estimation circuit and its coherent irrep-row-column output normal form.
Efficient S_n generalized phase estimation for arbitrary implemented representations and Kronecker isotypic projectors.
Precedent that direct Clebsch-Gordan structure can turn a pretty-good measurement into an efficient HSP algorithm.

proof_obligations.resolution: Direct contraction gives E F=U/d on every carrier, and all finite normal-form controls match the SVD polar.
GPE exports the carrier coordinate while preserving the unknown multiplicity label; no multiplicity basis is exposed.
Reversibly decompose a permutation into O(n^2) adjacent transpositions and apply their sparse Young-orthogonal action to every one of O(log n!) tensor factors.
A pairwise carrier swap does not determine higher-level relative effects, coherent incidence, or a complete frame factorization.

summary: Derived a polynomial generalized-phase-estimation circuit for exact orientation-pair polar transport that preserves unknown Kronecker multiplicity labels and avoids inverse-dimension amplification.

theorem_contract.carrier_block_polar: On fixed alpha and multiplicity labels, E F=(1/d_alpha)U_alpha, where U_alpha maps |i>_a|Omega>_0b to |Omega>_0a|i>_b and preserves all multiplicity labels.
theorem_contract.direct_circuit: Apply GPE to blocks 0,a,b; on equal irrep labels swap the a,b QFT row registers; invert all GPE calls. This equals the pair cross-overlap polar on its support.
theorem_contract.gpe_normal_form: For R(g)=direct_sum_alpha I_M tensor rho_alpha(g), coherent generalized phase estimation maps |alpha,j,i> to d_alpha^-1/2 sum_t |alpha,i,t>|alpha,j,t>.
theorem_contract.scope_exclusion: The theorem supplies pair transport only. It does not construct higher-level relative-frame isometries or the complete many-orientation PGM polar.
theorem_contract.symmetric_group_complexity: S_n QFT, uniform-group preparation, equality tests, and controlled tensor products of sparse Young-orthogonal adjacent-transposition gates all have polynomial-size uniform circuits.
